meta.name: pieces-ltm
meta.description: Pieces Long-Term Memory integration skill. Auto-persists memories after every skill chain, improves retrieval quality, and provides a Python wrapper for the Pieces MCP tools. Use after every non-trivial operation to ensure context is never lost.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动保存对话记忆，随时找回上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常和 AI 助手长谈，却总担心它忘记之前的上下文
copy.tagline_en: Automatically save conversation memory and recall context anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often have long conversations with AI but worry it forgets context

howto.what: 任务链路结束后，自动把任务描述、关键决策、改动文件和结果存入 Pieces 长期记忆，并按决策、修复等类型分类；之后提问可检索这些历史。
howto.when: 当一条任务链满足非平凡条件（至少 4 个技能触发且改动至少 1 个文件）时自动触发；也可在你提到 pieces、ltm、memory 等关键词时进入。

say.text: 把这次修复 numpy 序列化问题的过程和关键决定存进长期记忆。
say.note: 会用 pieces-ltm 写入一条 bugfix 记忆。

say.text: 查一下我们之前为什么选了 Flask 而不是 FastAPI？
say.note: 会按 type=decision 检索决策历史。

say.text: 总结一下我这周做过哪些工作。
say.note: 会检索本周的上下文并汇总。

howto.what_en: After a task chain finishes, it automatically stores the task description, key decisions, changed files, and outcome into Pieces long-term memory, classifies them by type (e.g. decision, bugfix), and later lets you retrieve that history.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically when a chain is non-trivial (4+ skills fired and 1+ files modified), or when you mention keywords like pieces, ltm, memory, or context.

say_en.text: Save the process and key decisions of this numpy fix to long-term memory.
say_en.note: Writes a bugfix memory via pieces-ltm.

say_en.text: Why did we choose Flask over FastAPI?
